hints.title: Quadruplet Index Inversion
hints.text: The pattern requires i < j < k < l with nums[i] < nums[k] < nums[j] < nums[l].

hints.title: Fixing Intermediate Indices
hints.text: Fix the pair (j, k) with j < k and nums[k] < nums[j].

hints.title: Prefix and Suffix Counting
hints.text: Count how many indices i < j satisfy nums[i] < nums[k], and how many indices l > k satisfy nums[l] > nums[j].

hints.title: 1324 Quadruplet Counting Implementation

complexity.interviewerExpectation: Fixes middle inverted pair (j, k) and multiplies independent prefix/suffix counts.
